exposure: Umbilical vein blood flow normalized for fetal abdominal circumference (UVBF/AC)
Presence or absence of composite adverse perinatal outcome
outcome: Composite adverse perinatal outcome (emergency Cesarean section for fetal distress, 5-min Apgar score < 7, umbilical artery pH < 7.10, neonatal admission to the special care unit)
cohort: 243 singleton pregnancies complicated by late-onset FGR
finding: UVBF/AC at the time of late-onset FGR diagnosis showed better accuracy for predicting composite adverse perinatal outcome than CPR or uterine artery PI.
